gridley player 1350 = afldb 2489: Gridley omits, AFLDB lists; gridley_key_inconsistent on captain (2026-10-01, AFLDB-ISSUE-225 §19.2 D4 D10) [D10 guard: AFLDB satisfies ME, and Gridley's key lists him under ME elsewhere in the corpus]: AFLDB trusted_captaincies:Melbourne=2008; independent: Melbourne co-captain with James McDonald for rounds 6-22 of 2008 after David Neitz retired (Wikipedia: 2008 Melbourne Football Club season, infobox captains; Melbourne FC: Bruce 'stepped up as co-acting captain with James McDonald'; accessed 2026-10-01). Gridley's own key is temporally inconsistent for him: of the 177 stored captain cells it lists him on none of the 144 before 2026 and on 11 of the 33 in 2026, and of the pre-2026 omissions it contradicts, 26 are on captain x X pairs it lists him under in 2026 and 11 more on an X it lists him under elsewhere (AFLDB-ISSUE-225 E1, D10). Applies only where AFLDB satisfies the other criterion of the cell and Gridley's key lists him under that same criterion elsewhere in the corpus (D10 guard).
